title: Quarters Skills: create → edit → delete a loose skill from the UI
summary: This e2e drives the full create → edit → delete cycle for a loose skill, but the recorded run FAILED: only the create-and-save half actually completed. The four captured actions all succeeded — land on `/quarters/skills`, open the New-skill drawer, type `demo-skill-e2e` (which prefills the SKILL.md template), and click Create — and that click POSTs `{action:"file.create", surface:"skill"}` to `/api/quarters`, writing a loose SKILL.md straight into `~/.claude/skills/`. What did NOT run in this sandbox is everything the test asserts AFTER that save: the new row appearing in the list, the Edit round-trip, and the Remove/confirm delete. Those later steps are narrated as not-verified, not as a passing happy path.

states.label: /quarters/skills
states.description: The Quarters Skills surface, reached by the dynamic `[type]` route with `type = skills`. The captured half of this run creates a loose skill and saves it; the edit and delete legs the title promises did not complete in this run.

steps.title: The [type] route resolves `skills` to the primitive list panel
steps.description: `/quarters/skills` lands on the single dynamic Quarters page. It looks the slug up in the category table (`categoryBySlug("skills")`), 404s on an unknown one, then dispatches on kind. `skills` is `kind: "primitives"`, so it renders `PrimitiveListPanel` — the same generic panel every package surface (Hooks/MCPs/Scripts…) uses — passing it the resolved category.

steps.title: Click `create-skill` opens the New-skill drawer
steps.description: The panel renders one create button per creatable surface; for `skills` that is a single `data-testid="create-skill"` button (the testid is `create-${surface}`). Clicking it doesn't fetch anything — it just sets `editing = { surface: "skill", rec: null }`, and `rec: null` is what tells the editor it is in CREATE mode. That state mounts the skill editor drawer (`FilePrimitiveForm`) further down the component.

steps.title: Fill `demo-skill-e2e` — the name prefills the SKILL.md template
steps.description: This is not an inert text box. On create, typing into the name field also rewrites the still-pristine content: as long as the body is untouched, each keystroke calls `setContent(template(next))`, so `demo-skill-e2e` flows into the SKILL.md frontmatter (`name: demo-skill-e2e`). That is exactly what the test's very next assertion checks (`file-content` matches `name: demo-skill-e2e`). This step is real UI logic, so it is kept as code rather than folded to glue.

steps.title: Click `file-save` — POST file.create writes the loose skill
steps.description: The last recorded action, and the climax of the half that ran. The `file-save` button calls `save()`, which — because `rec` is null (create) — builds the body `{action:"file.create", surface:"skill", name:"demo-skill-e2e", content}` and POSTs it to `/api/quarters`. On a non-ok response or `ok:false` it throws into the drawer's error banner; on success it calls `onSaved()` to close the drawer and reload the list. This POST is what the write-path step describes; it is also where the recorded capture ends.

steps.title: The write path — /api/quarters → createFilePrimitive
steps.description: The POST hits `src/app/api/quarters/route.ts`, whose handler calls `runQuartersAction(body)`. The `file.create` case dispatches to `createFilePrimitive(surface, name, content)` — a direct Garrison filesystem write of a loose skill under `~/.claude/skills/`, NOT an `apm install` (APM only owns the promote/park lifecycle for skills, not a hand-authored loose one). The handler returns `{ok:true}` and the panel refetches `/api/quarters`. That much succeeded in this run.

next.label: …but the rest of the cycle did not run

steps.asciiSample:
POST /api/quarters
  { action: "file.create", surface: "skill",
    name: "demo-skill-e2e", content: "---\nname: demo-skill-e2e\n..." }

-> runQuartersAction()  (src/lib/quarters.ts, case "file.create")
-> createFilePrimitive("skill", "demo-skill-e2e", content)
-> writes ~/.claude/skills/demo-skill-e2e/SKILL.md   (loose, Garrison-direct)
<- { ok: true }

steps.title: What this run did NOT verify (edit → delete)
steps.description: runStatus = failed. Beyond the save above, the test goes on to assert the new `primitive-skill:demo-skill-e2e` row is visible, then Edit it (reload body, change it, save via `file.update`), then Remove it (Remove → confirm dialog → `file.delete`, row count back to 0), and finally that the seeded `garrison-memory` skill survives. None of that edit → delete cycle completed in this sandbox run, so it is stated here as unverified rather than narrated as a pass.
